rationale.edition: All changed file paths live under web/src/** (plugins/logs, plugins/traces, composables/useLogs, locales/languages) plus scripts/translations/. No path is under an enterprise-owned directory (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/) and no enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/etc.) appear in the changed paths or symbols, so this is an open-source change.
rationale.skip: Not skipping. There is no explicit opt-out (no tests-added label, empty trigger comment), and the change is not docs/CI-only. It alters user-facing UI in web/src: the View Trace action now renders in the DetailTable row-detail drawer header and JsonPreview, and TraceTree's View Logs action gains validation toasts and a navigation fix.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted. The View Trace button + traces-stream picker are real user-exercisable controls whose visibility is gated by service_streams_enabled, hiddenMenus, and the trace_id field, and the trace-tree View Logs action now surfaces warning toasts when no logs stream is selected or the raw span is missing. These flows need browser-level verification.
rationale.area: Logs is the dominant area: the new composable lives in composables/useLogs, and the bulk of the substantive UI changes are in plugins/logs/DetailTable.vue and plugins/logs/JsonPreview.vue. The traces changes (TraceTree.vue, TraceDetails.vue) are secondary bugfixes/layout tweaks, so the spec belongs with the Logs-area siblings.
rationale.group: The View Trace action is a feature-level logs capability (not core search), matching the Logs-Features shard where sibling feature specs like searchPatterns.spec.js live; the enterprise overlay also extends Logs-Core/Logs-Features, confirming Logs-Features is the closest existing matrix group.
rationale.existing_tests: No Playwright E2E specs in the diff. The changed .spec.ts files (useViewTraceAction.spec.ts, DetailTable.spec.ts, JsonPreview.spec.ts, TraceTree.spec.ts) are Vitest unit tests under web/src/**, which are not E2E coverage and do not set existing_tests_in_diff.
